whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Four Seasons,

I noticed your restaurant has exceptional 4.4★ reviews from 458+ happy customers in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online table bookings and food orders.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, digital menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/fourseasons

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Four Seasons, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, a digital food menu showcase, and your Kankarbagh location map. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
